The verdict carries two 3mp recognition clauses in sequence: 28:22 ("וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֤י עָלַ֨יִךְ֙ צִיד֔וֹן וְנִכְבַּדְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בַּעֲשׂ֥וֹתִי בָ֛הּ שְׁפָטִ֖ים וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָֽהּ", oshb:Ezek.28.22) and 28:23 ("וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי בָ֞הּ דֶּ֤בֶר וָדָם֙ בְּח֣וּצוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְנִפְלַ֤ל חָלָל֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ בְּחֶ֥רֶב עָלֶ֖יהָ מִסָּבִ֑יב וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה", oshb:Ezek.28.23); both are disclosed as internal, paragraph-final refrains rather than the row's close, since no fresh onset device separates them from what follows (28:22-24 read as one continuous accusation-then-plague verdict against the same addressee). Close (both sides): 28:24 ends "וְלֹֽא יִהְיֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל סִלּ֤וֹן מַמְאִיר֙ וְק֣וֹץ מַכְאִ֔ב מִכֹּל֙ סְבִ֣יבֹתָ֔ם הַשָּׁאטִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה" (oshb:Ezek.28.24), pivoting from Sidon (2fs) to "the house of Israel" (3mp) while itself closing on an Adonai-form recognition variant ("then they shall know that I am the Lord YHWH"), with a SAMEKH immediately after — this SAMEKH is the Masoretic paragraph's own mark, confirming the row's close rather than diverging from it. Behind this row, 28:19 closed the king-of-Tyre qinah on parashah evidence alone; ahead, 28:25 opens a fresh messenger formula for the Israel-gathering promise.
